title: Add two 64-bit numbers
task: a and b are 64-bit numbers, each in two words, the low word first: a at 0x800 and 0x804, b at 0x808 and 0x80C. Store a + b, modulo 2^64, at sum: the low word at 0x810, the high word at 0x814; then end with B . . Add the low words with ADDS and the high words with ADC, which adds the carry. To run it in a processor view, choose "Extended datapath" in the instruction-set menu: immediates there are 0 to 255. Keep the .equ lines: the tests write the data at those addresses.
starter:
; add64 -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, ARMv7)
; Store the 64-bit sum of a and b.
; Hint: ADDS for the low words, ADC for the high words.
        .equ  alo, 0x800        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  ahi, 0x804        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  blo, 0x808        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  bhi, 0x80C        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  slo, 0x810        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  shi, 0x814        ; the tests write and read here

done:   B     done           ; replace with your code; B . ends the run
